# Fil One Documentation

> Fil One is S3-compatible object storage built for AI agents and data-intensive
> workloads. Stored on the Filecoin network, where storage providers must
> continuously submit cryptographic proofs that they still hold the data they
> committed to store. No egress fees on paid plans, no per-request charges,
> $5.99/TB/month with a $5.99/month minimum.
> Use any S3-compatible SDK or tool — point it at your region's endpoint,
> `https://s3.<region>.filonecontent.com`, with standard Access Key ID / Secret Access Key
> auth. Endpoint, region and key must all refer to the same region.

Critical integration notes for developers:
- CreateBucket and DeleteBucket via the S3 API are region-dependent: supported
  in us-east-1, unavailable in eu-west-1 (use the dashboard there). The dashboard
  can delete a bucket in EVERY region, including eu-west-1, but only for Owner
  and Admin roles and only once the bucket is EMPTY (no objects or versions)
- Path-style addressing required: `https://s3.eu-west-1.filonecontent.com/bucket/key`
  (virtual-hosted-style URLs are not supported)
- Access keys are scoped to ONE region and cannot be used against another
- Region, versioning, Object Lock and retention are fixed at bucket creation and
  cannot be changed afterwards (no update-bucket operation)
- Authentication: AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) — all S3-compatible SDKs
  handle this automatically
- All buckets are private by default; all data is encrypted at rest and in
  transit (TLS); encryption cannot be disabled. At-rest encryption is done by the
  regional storage gateway and keys are held by the regional operator, NOT by Fil
  One and NOT customer-managed. Do not name a specific cipher or SSE mode.
  SSE-KMS is rejected in BOTH regions (InvalidRequest in us-east-1; AccessDenied
  or InvalidRequest in eu-west-1) and SSE-C is unsupported — send no encryption
  headers at all. In eu-west-1, Get/PutBucketEncryption also return AccessDenied,
  so no encryption configuration can be read or written there
- Regions: eu-west-1 Europe (France, default) and us-east-1 US East (Michigan)
- Deletion is permanent and immediate on non-versioned buckets (no recycle bin).
  On versioned buckets an S3-API delete WITHOUT a version ID places a delete
  marker and prior versions are retained and still billed. The DASHBOARD NEVER
  WRITES A DELETE MARKER: a console delete (single or bulk) permanently removes
  the specific version on the row chosen, even on a versioned bucket
- CopyObject / server-side copy is confirmed working in us-east-1, including
  copying a specific version onto the current key to promote it (a version
  restore). In eu-west-1 PLAIN COPY WORKS but the version-id form is UNVERIFIED
  (the harness cannot configure versioning over the API there); download and
  re-upload is the fallback. The dashboard has no restore/roll-back button either way
- Per-object CIDs, deal IDs, and sealing state are NOT exposed — customers
  cannot independently audit an individual object
- A failed payment (past_due) makes the DASHBOARD READ-ONLY from the moment the
  payment fails, not after a later deadline; Stripe retries the charge
- Trial caps are enforcement thresholds, not allowances: storage reaching 1 TB
  WRITE-LOCKS the account (lifted on the next usage run once storage is back
  under 1 TB); egress reaching 2 TB DISABLES it entirely, with NO read-only grace
  period first. Trial egress is a single cumulative budget over the 30 days.
  Enforced by a twice-daily job (~07:00/19:00 UTC), not in real time
- Storage is DECIMAL: 1 TB = 1,000 GB, 1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes
- Governance Object Lock has NO grantable bypass permission in the product
- PutObjectRetention (per-object retention) and Legal Hold
  (Get/PutObjectLegalHold) work in BOTH REGIONS, including Governance-mode bypass
  and blocking delete while a hold is active. Both need the matching granular key
  permission, which is never granted automatically, and only an organization
  OWNER can create a key with PutObjectRetention or PutObjectLegalHold.
  Evidence differs by region: us-east-1 from the automated compatibility suite,
  eu-west-1 from engineering testing (the suite could not create a lock-enabled
  bucket there)
- The S3 API has NO IAM users, roles, or bucket policies: each request is allowed
  or refused by the access key's own permissions and bucket scope. The CONSOLE
  has organizations (BETA) with four member roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Read
  only); a key can only carry permissions its creator's role holds
- Access keys can be ROTATED in the dashboard (new Access Key ID and secret,
  same name/permissions/buckets/region/expiry; old secret stops working at once)
- Object/part size limits (5 TB object, 5 GB single-PUT, 10,000 parts, 5 MB min
  part) are standard AWS S3 values, NOT independently confirmed for Fil One
- Bucket names forbid dots (unlike AWS S3); object keys are capped at 1,024
  CHARACTERS for dashboard uploads (code-backed); through the S3 API the standard
  S3 limit of 1,024 bytes applies but is NOT independently confirmed
- In eu-west-1, UNIMPLEMENTED OPERATIONS RETURN AccessDenied (403), NOT
  NotImplemented (501), and a bucket/key you cannot see returns 403 instead of
  404. A 403 from PutBucketVersioning, PutBucketPolicy, PutBucketAcl,
  PutBucketEncryption, PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration or the tagging operations
  means the FEATURE IS ABSENT, not that the key lacks a permission
- ACL requests fail two different ways in eu-west-1: a canned-ACL HEADER on an
  upload (--acl public-read) is SILENTLY IGNORED and the upload SUCCEEDS, while a
  DEDICATED call (Put/GetBucketAcl, Put/GetObjectAcl) is REJECTED with
  AccessDenied. Neither makes an object public
- Error CODES deviate from AWS in eu-west-1 even though the XML format is
  standard: BadDigest->InvalidArgument, InvalidRange->InvalidArgument,
  InvalidTag->BadRequest, BucketAlreadyExists->BucketAlreadyOwnedByYou. Some
  invalid requests are also ACCEPTED where AWS returns 400
- Open eu-west-1 client-affecting bugs: ListObjects NextMarker can carry an
  internal suffix (use ListObjectsV2 + ContinuationToken instead);
  EncodingType=url encodes a space as "+" not "%20"; additional-checksum
  operations are unreliable (ChecksumType may be missing from
  CompleteMultipartUpload responses)

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.filone.com/quickstart): Create an account, generate
  API keys, and upload your first object — covers App, AWS CLI, Python, and
  JavaScript paths
- [Quickstart - AWS CLI](https://docs.filone.com/quickstart/cli): Full CLI walkthrough
  including named profile setup to avoid repeating --endpoint-url
- [Quickstart - SDK](https://docs.filone.com/quickstart/sdk): Copy-paste examples
  for Python (boto3), JavaScript (AWS SDK v3), and Go to create a bucket, upload,
  and verify

## Storage

- [Buckets](https://docs.filone.com/storage/buckets): Bucket naming rules, how to
  create via dashboard, listing via API, deleting (bucket must be EMPTY; dashboard
  delete works in every region for Owner/Admin roles; S3-API DeleteBucket in
  us-east-1 only), and Filecoin deal lifecycle on deletion
- [Objects](https://docs.filone.com/storage/objects): Upload, download, list, delete,
  and presigned URL generation with code examples for App, AWS CLI, and boto3.
  Dashboard has multi-select delete and Empty bucket; a dashboard delete on a
  versioned bucket PERMANENTLY removes that version (no delete marker), while an
  S3-API delete without a version ID writes a delete marker
- [Multipart Uploads](https://docs.filone.com/storage/multipart-uploads): Required
  above the single-PUT ceiling (standard S3 5 GB, not independently confirmed);
  recommended for > 100 MB. Dashboard uploads are single-PUT; multipart is via
  your own SDK/CLI. No lifecycle rule to auto-abort incomplete uploads. Cleanup
  needs List (list uploads) and Write (abort); us-east-1 keys created before
  26 August 2026 lack these multipart actions (403), so replace them
- [Versioning](https://docs.filone.com/storage/versioning): Opt-in at bucket
  creation, cannot be suspended. S3-API delete without a version ID writes a
  delete marker; the DASHBOARD NEVER DOES, it permanently deletes the chosen
  version. Version operations need granular key permissions (List object
  versions, Read object versions, Delete object versions), none granted
  automatically
- [Object Lock](https://docs.filone.com/storage/object-lock): WORM retention.
  Opt-in at bucket creation, Governance (default) and Compliance modes, 1 day to
  100 years, no trial-specific cap. NO third-party compliance attestation, NO
  grantable Governance bypass permission in the product. Per-object
  PutObjectRetention and Legal Hold work in both regions.
  Regulations (SEC 17a-4, FINRA, HIPAA) are illustrative
  use cases, not a certification claim

## Security

- [Account Security](https://docs.filone.com/security/account-security): securing
  the account you sign in with (distinct from API request auth). Sign-in via
  passkeys (primary), Google, GitHub, or email with password; email
  verification is mandatory before the dashboard opens. Opt-in two-factor with
  three factor types: authenticator app (OTP), security key (WebAuthn roaming),
  device biometrics (WebAuthn platform). SMS and email codes are deliberately
  NOT offered. Up to 20 passkeys per account. Single-use recovery codes.
  Removing a factor or passkey, removing all factors, and regenerating a
  recovery code all require a session established with 2FA or a passkey
  (step-up). Transferring organization ownership also needs a sign-in within the
  last five minutes (with 2FA or a passkey if 2FA is set up)
- [Authentication](https://docs.filone.com/security/authentication): SigV4 auth
  setup for AWS CLI, Python (boto3), JavaScript (AWS SDK v3), and Go; credential
  best practices including environment variable usage
- [API Keys](https://docs.filone.com/security/api-keys): Creating keys with scoped
  permissions (Read/Write/List/Delete), CreateBucket/DeleteBucket and
  GetBucketVersioning/GetBucketObjectLockConfiguration groups, single-region
  scoping, bucket-level scoping, key expiration, ROTATION, revocation, best
  practices. Read in us-east-1 also includes ListBucket (not in eu-west-1); Write
  without Delete can still OVERWRITE. A key can only carry permissions its
  creator's organization role holds; PutObjectRetention/PutObjectLegalHold are
  Owner-only. Names starting with `filone-console` are reserved
- [Encryption](https://docs.filone.com/security/encryption): server-side
  encryption always on by default for all objects; TLS in transit; keys held by
  the regional operator (no customer-managed keys, cipher unconfirmed).
  Client-side encryption is up to you — AWS's S3 Encryption Client exists only
  for Java/.NET/Go/Ruby, NOT boto3/CLI/JS v3

## Billing

- [Trial & Billing](https://docs.filone.com/billing/trial): 30-day free trial with
  1 TB storage (1,000 GB) and 2 TB egress (cumulative); the trial starts after
  EMAIL VERIFICATION, one trial per email address, invited members get none;
  storage cap write-locks, egress cap disables the account directly (no
  read-only grace first); trial lifecycle (active → grace → expiry); a failed
  payment makes the dashboard read-only immediately; Pay as you go
  $5.99/TB/month, $5.99/month minimum, no egress or request fees (earlier
  subscribers keep their $4.99 or per-unit terms); Business plan
  (1, 3, or 5-year terms) via sales. Cancellation is via the Stripe portal
- [Pricing](https://docs.filone.com/billing/pricing): Pay as you go $5.99/TB/month
  (decimal TB, 1,000 GB) with a $5.99/month minimum; single linear rate plus a
  floor (no first-TB tier); storage measured as daily readings and averaged, with
  the running average reported twice daily; no egress or per-request charges.
  Organizations that subscribed before the move to $5.99 keep $4.99/TB with a
  $4.99 minimum; accounts predating any minimum have none
- [Usage](https://docs.filone.com/billing/usage): What is measured (average stored
  bytes, egress), trial caps and how they are enforced; the storage write-lock
  lifts on the next usage run once storage is back under 1 TB. Billing page
  visible to Owners and Admins

## API Reference

- [API Reference Overview](https://docs.filone.com/reference/overview): Base endpoint,
  SigV4 authentication requirement, path-style addressing, and response format
- [S3 Compatibility](https://docs.filone.com/reference/s3-compatibility): Full table
  of supported vs. unsupported S3 operations (GetObject, PutObject, DeleteObject,
  ListObjectsV2, multipart, presigned URLs all supported; bucket policies, lifecycle
  rules, IAM users/roles/bucket policies on the S3 API not yet supported; access
  is per access key permissions and bucket scope); how unsupported operations respond in eu-west-1
  (AccessDenied, not NotImplemented); known error-code deviations and known
  behavioral issues in eu-west-1; differences from AWS S3
- [Error Reference](https://docs.filone.com/reference/errors): Standard S3 XML error
  format, full table of 4xx and 5xx error codes, the ways codes deviate from AWS,
  console errors (account/region still being set up: 503; role does not permit
  the action: 403), and troubleshooting for the most common errors
  (SignatureDoesNotMatch, AccessDenied, ServiceUnavailable)

## SDKs & Tools

- [SDKs & Tools Overview](https://docs.filone.com/sdk/overview): Connection parameters
  for all tools (endpoint, region, credentials); recommended tools list including
  rclone, Cyberduck, s3cmd, MinIO Client
- [Python (boto3)](https://docs.filone.com/sdk/python): Full examples for upload,
  download, list, delete, multipart, presigned URLs, and error handling
- [JavaScript (AWS SDK v3)](https://docs.filone.com/sdk/javascript): Full examples
  for Node.js including streaming downloads, pagination, presigned URLs, and
  error handling; requires `forcePathStyle: true`
- [Go (aws-sdk-go-v2)](https://docs.filone.com/sdk/go): Full examples for upload,
  download, paginated listing, presigned URLs, and error handling; requires
  `UsePathStyle: true`
- [AWS CLI](https://docs.filone.com/sdk/cli): Installation, named-profile
  configuration, core operations, multipart uploads and cleanup. `aws s3 rb`
  works in us-east-1 only; in eu-west-1 delete buckets from the dashboard
  (Owner and Admin roles)

## Optional

The browser console at app.filone.com, one page per console screen. No code
required. Each page below is console-specific; the capability pages (Storage,
Security, Billing) hold the concepts and code samples.

- [App - Dashboard](https://docs.filone.com/app/dashboard): Console home. Quick
  setup checklist, PLAN/STORAGE/EGRESS cards (PLAN shown to Owner/Admin only),
  Usage Trends (Storage area chart with latest reading; Egress bar chart with
  the window total), Recent Activity. Storage is a periodic point-in-time reading
  (a very recent change may not show yet) and egress is a rolling 30-day total,
  not a calendar month. "Est. monthly cost" applies your plan's per-TB price to
  the latest reading with the monthly minimum as the floor (not shown without a
  per-TB rate), while the invoice uses AVERAGE storage, so they differ. Recent
  Activity covers bucket and key creation; object-level events are not included
  yet
- [App - Buckets](https://docs.filone.com/app/buckets): Bucket list (Name, Region,
  Created; sorted by name; search, sortable columns and region filter from 5
  buckets), create form, object browser, upload, object detail, download/share,
  delete. DELETE BUCKET from the row's actions menu: Owner/Admin only, EMPTY
  buckets only, works in EVERY region including eu-west-1 (where S3-API
  DeleteBucket is unavailable). "Empty bucket" removes every object, version and
  delete marker server-side. Multi-select delete via checkboxes. A console delete
  on a versioned bucket PERMANENTLY deletes the chosen version (NO delete
  marker). Property cards: Versioning, Object Lock, Retention (no Encryption
  card; always on). Name, region, versioning, Object Lock and default retention
  are PERMANENT at creation (no update-bucket op). Upload is single-PUT (5 GB
  ceiling); folder uploads skip system files; the browser shows the first ~1,000
  entries and the tab count is a daily reading that can lag; no version
  restore/promote (download and re-upload). Download works on trial; SHARING IS
  A PAID-PLAN FEATURE
- [App - API Keys](https://docs.filone.com/app/api-keys): Key list (Name, Region,
  Buckets, Permissions, Created by, Status, Last Used) and create flow. Region is
  REQUIRED (pre-set to eu-west-1) and a key is scoped to its own region's
  endpoint. Read/Write/List pre-selected, Delete NOT; finer-grained permissions
  (retention, legal hold, versions) are granted INDIVIDUALLY, so Write alone
  cannot set retention. "Create bucket"/"Delete bucket" unavailable in
  eu-west-1. Role ceiling: Read only cannot create keys, Members manage only
  their own, Admins/Owners manage all; Set retention/Set legal hold are
  Owner-only. `filone-console` name prefix reserved. Secret shown ONCE (at
  creation or rotation) and never stored. ROTATE gives a new Access Key ID and
  secret keeping name, permissions, buckets, region and expiry; the old secret
  stops working at once; expired keys can't be rotated. Delete is the
  revocation. "Last Used" and "Status" are placeholder columns reading
  "Never"/"Active" for every key, and expiry is not shown after creation
- [App - AI Agent Toolkit](https://docs.filone.com/app/ai-agent-toolkit): NOT
  RELEASED. A "Coming Soon" page introducing the toolkit plus a waitlist form, so
  there is nothing to set up on it yet. What DOES work today: ordinary S3 access
  keys scoped to a bucket, which is how LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK and
  CrewAI connect
- [App - Organization](https://docs.filone.com/app/organization): BETA. Every
  account starts as a one-person organization with you as Owner. The
  ORGANIZATION MENU at the top of the sidebar opens separate pages, each shown
  only to roles that can use it: Edit organization (/edit-organization; name,
  logo, and an Owner-only Danger zone), Members (/members; Members and
  Invitations tabs), Billing (/billing), and Audit log (/audit).
  Members, Audit log, Create organization and
  sending invitations are beta-only. With no active plan, only Settings, Edit
  organization and Support are reachable.
  Four roles: Owner, Admin, Member, Read only. Only Owners manage billing,
  transfer ownership, or create keys with PutObjectRetention/PutObjectLegalHold;
  Owners and Admins invite, change roles, remove members, rename the org, and
  delete buckets. Roles apply in the console; the S3 API has no users or roles,
  and a key is capped at its creator's role. Narrowing a role or removing a
  member REVOKES their keys that exceed it. At least one Owner always; transfer
  makes you Admin and needs a sign-in within five minutes. The beta gates
  SENDING INVITATIONS: single-use links, expire in 14 days, max 25 pending.
  Audit log kept 90 days, CSV export up to 20,000 rows. Organization switching
  is in the organization menu and per browser tab; leave an organization from
  Settings (not as its last Owner). Deleting an organization is not available
  in the console yet (support@fil.one)
- [App - Billing](https://docs.filone.com/app/billing): Plan card, usage card,
  payment method, choosing a plan, invoices, "Need help?" panel. Its own page
  at /billing, opened from the organization menu at the top of the sidebar. Visible to
  Owners and Admins; every action is Owner-only. A FAILED PAYMENT shows a
  "Payment failed" badge and a "Your last payment failed" banner, and makes the
  DASHBOARD read-only. Usage card shows Storage and Egress (egress "Free" on
  paid) and an "Estimated total" on per-TB plans. Payment method: "No card on
  file", card brand and last four, or "Billed by invoice". "Choose your plan":
  Pay as you go ($5.99/TB/month, $5.99 minimum) or Business plan (custom
  pricing, 1, 3, or 5-year terms). Invoices list shows the
  12 most recent issued invoices, INCLUDING UNPAID (drafts not shown). Card
  details live in the Stripe portal, which is also where cancellation happens
- [App - Settings](https://docs.filone.com/app/settings): Profile fields (full name
  <= 200 chars; valid email, disposable rejected; the organization's name is not
  part of the profile and is edited on the Edit organization page), an
  Organizations section to switch or leave organizations, notification preferences (Marketing
  emails only; no upload or storage-limit notification setting), pointer to
  Account Security. Changing your email RESETS VERIFICATION and re-triggers the
  verification-screen redirect; Google/GitHub sign-ins manage name and email at
  the provider. The "Danger zone" card covers "Delete account": not available in
  the console yet, email support@fil.one
- [App - Support](https://docs.filone.com/app/support): The "Talk to an expert" form,
  opened from "Support" in the user menu at the bottom of the sidebar. All fields required, starts empty, four
  categories, ~1 business day response. Replies arrive by email; the console does
  not show a ticket list. Sales: "Contact sales team" in the "Choose your plan"
  dialog, or "Talk to sales" in Billing's "Need help?" panel on trial/no plan
- [FAQ](https://docs.filone.com/faq): Common questions on S3 compatibility,
  blockchain/crypto requirements, data residency, deletion behavior, migration
  from AWS S3, backups, durability, multiple users (organizations, in beta),
  and Filecoin data integrity mechanics
- [Limits & Quotas](https://docs.filone.com/limits): Account limits (storage,
  egress, buckets), object size limits (max 5 TB, use multipart above 5 GB),
  API rate limits, and bucket/key naming constraints (object keys 1,024
  characters in the dashboard; 1,024 bytes via the API, standard S3 and not
  independently confirmed)
